answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Inheritance & Will Question ID: 48250 Country: Pakistan Title: Distribution of assets & propertires among children & wife Question: I wanted to know how the income (in term of rental money) of father and property should be distributed among 3 children (2 sons and 1 daughter) and wife after the death of our father, in the light of Quran and Sunnah. We wanted to settle things before his death. Answer ID: 48250 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1475/1134/B=11/1434) A father is the owner of his property and income during his lifetime. His children do not have any share or right in it. Only after the death of father his children shall become eligible in his property. Hence now the distribution of father’s inheritance and the division of heirs is not correct. If at the time of your father’s death only the said heirs were alive then after the death of your father the amount of rent and the value of property shall be divided into 40 shares. Out of total, eights part i.e. 5 shares shall go to his wife, 14-14 shares to each son and the daughter shall receive 7 shares. The Shariah division is as follows: Details: Wife: 1x05=05 Sons: 2x14=28 Daughter: 1x01=07 Total: 40 Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
